source_name: ATVP (Securities Market Agency) – Izrečeni ukrepi / nadzorniška razkritja
why_relevant: Sanctions and measures against investment firms, fund managers and market-abuse cases; the securities-side counterpart to the BS register and relevant for MiCA/MiFID and crypto-asset service providers operating in payments-adjacent space.

source_name: AZN – Agencija za zavarovalni nadzor, Izrečeni ukrepi
why_relevant: Insurance supervisor's published measures (licence revocations, remediation orders). Useful as a cross-sector supervisory-intensity benchmark and for bancassurance distribution conduct issues at bank branches.

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) – Strokovna izobraževanja / Training Centre
why_relevant: The main Slovenian provider of banking training. A new course on a named regulation, or a certification exam being added, dates the industry's implementation window and reveals which obligations banks feel unprepared for.

source_name: Optius.com – job listings, Bančništvo & Finance category
why_relevant: Aggregates SI banking/finance vacancies across employers, including compliance roles ('Svetovalec za skladnost poslovanja'). Cheapest single vantage point for cross-bank compliance-hiring trend and for regulation names appearing in requirements.

source_name: Zavod RS za zaposlovanje (ESS) – national job vacancy search
why_relevant: Statutory national vacancy register; broadest legal coverage of SI postings including those banks must register. Good baseline denominator for compliance-hiring counts.

source_name: NLB Group careers – prosta delovna mesta
why_relevant: Largest SI banking group; individual job pages carry stable IDs and full requirement text. A posting for e.g. a DORA/ICT-risk or AMLR readiness role dates that group's implementation programme.

source_name: OTP banka Slovenija – Kariera
why_relevant: Second major SI bank (merged NKBM/SKB perimeter); career page text surfaced compliance ('skladnost poslovanja') and PSD2 terminology, i.e. regulation names appear directly in role descriptions.

source_name: Deželna banka Slovenije – Zaposlitve
why_relevant: Smaller domestic bank; compliance hiring at a small institution is a strong signal that an obligation has become binding for the whole market rather than only large SSM-supervised groups.

source_name: Bankart d.o.o. – Zaposlitev (national card/payment processor)
why_relevant: Slovenia's dominant payment-instrument processor. Hiring for instant-payments, ISO 20022, DORA/ICT-resilience or fraud-prevention roles is the clearest early signal of payment-infrastructure regulatory workload (IPR, PSD3, DORA TLPT) and of vendor opportunity timing.

source_name: LinkedIn – Bankart d.o.o. company page (and SI bank/PSP company pages)
why_relevant: Job posts and headcount/role-title changes at SI banks and PSPs, plus employee announcements of new compliance functions. Frequently carries postings not mirrored on corporate sites.

source_name: Borza dela – SI job aggregator (employer-scoped queries)
why_relevant: Secondary SI vacancy aggregator with employer-keyword URL patterns; useful redundancy when a bank removes a posting from its own site before the analyst sweep.

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – published sanctions and enforcement
why_relevant: SSM-level sanctions and enforcement against significant institutions, including any Slovenian SI (NLB) or NCA-imposed sanctions requested by the ECB. Complements the national register, which will not carry SSM-level cases.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register of supervised entities (SI institution perimeter)
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map: the full list of banks, savings banks, payment institutions and e-money institutions to whose career pages, event participation and sanctions the whole cell must be snowballed.

source_name: Planet GV – conference and workshop calendar (incl. Davčno-finančna konferenca)
why_relevant: Largest commercial SI business-education organiser; its programme pages date when a regulation becomes a paid-training topic. The Tax & Finance Conference (Portorož, Oct 2026) and standalone workshops carry named regulatory sessions and speaker affiliations.

source_name: Dnevi slovenskih pravnikov / GV Založba event programmes
why_relevant: Flagship SI legal conference; its banking/financial-law sections and paper titles are an early, citable indicator of which regulatory files (DORA, MiCA, AMLR, PSD3) the Slovenian legal-supervisory community treats as live.

source_name: Kapitalski dnevi (capital markets conference)
why_relevant: SI capital-markets event; agenda slots on listing rules, MiCA and market supervision indicate ATVP priorities and industry lobbying themes.

source_name: OPSI – Slovenian open data portal, supervisory-authority publishers
why_relevant: Machine-readable datasets published by ATVP and the AML Office (incl. records of inspections, violations and issued decisions). Where a dataset exists it is far more collectable than scraping HTML sanction lists.

source_name: EBA vacancy notices (Slovenian-language versions) and EU agencies job portal
why_relevant: EU-level supervisory hiring (e.g. a DORA Oversight Data Specialist at EBA) dates when the EU oversight machinery for a regulation actually becomes operational — the upstream analogue of national compliance hiring.

source_name: ATVP – Trg kriptosredstev (MiCA supervisory hub)
why_relevant: ATVP is the designated national competent authority (with Banka Slovenije) for CASP authorisation and supervision under MiCA / ZIUTK. This hub carries authorisation procedures, application forms, technical/IS guidance and reporting specifications with compliance dates for SI crypto-asset service providers.

source_name: ATVP – Registri (supervised entities and authorisation registers)
why_relevant: Authoritative national registers listing entities authorised by ATVP, including the CASP population; the actor-map spine for who is licensed, when, and for which services.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja (EMI register)
why_relevant: Statutory register of SI-licensed e-money institutions under ZPlaSSIED, including agents, branches and ceased entities. Primary evidence of the SI EMI population and licence changes.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register subjektov nadzora (supervised-entity register, entity pages)
why_relevant: Per-entity pages (e.g. Paywiser EMI) giving licence scope, services authorised and passporting — the granular layer under the aggregate registers, useful for tracking scope changes of individual fintechs.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Objave / novice (regulatory announcements feed)
why_relevant: Central announcement stream where BS publishes new sklepi, consultations, MiCA/PSD-related notices and deadline reminders affecting non-bank payment and crypto actors.

source_name: Vlada RS – gradiva.vlada.si (government legislative dossiers)
why_relevant: Full government materials incl. explanatory memoranda and stakeholder comment tables for finance/crypto bills; reveals which fintech and crypto associations lobbied and what they asked for.

source_name: Bankart – Open Banking API Developer Portal (PSD2 hub for SI banks)
why_relevant: Central SI PSD2/open-banking hub: Berlin Group API products, Swagger specs, sandbox and change/support notices covering most Slovenian banks through one onboarding. Where API specification changes and compliance dates surface for TPPs.

source_name: NLB Developer Portal
why_relevant: Largest SI bank's own PSD2/open-banking API programme: API products, OAuth2 authentication API, documentation and version notes — a direct read on how the incumbent exposes regulated interfaces and on migration deadlines for TPPs.

source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo ISBD Open Banking group portal – Slovenia (Intesa Sanpaolo Bank SI)
why_relevant: PSD2 API documentation for the Slovenian arm of an international group; shows group-level API standard convergence and change notices affecting SI TPP integrations.
